1	# Handoff to the next session
2	
3	State on 2026-10-11, about 06:30. Read `CLAUDE.md` first, then `changes.md` section "UI alignment" (U.1 to U.24): it records every decision of this session with its reason. **Nothing of this session is committed.**
4	
5	## 1. Do first: finish populating Supabase
6	
7	State at the end of the session (2026-10-11, about 09:00):
8	
9	- Supabase has migrations 0001 to 0016, the seed (10,128 verbatims, 13,771 signals, 13,404 with an embedding) and **1,657 cases from a build that failed in its last step**. Those cases have a page but no figures, no tags, no open state, no scores. There is no search index and there are no users.
10	- The build failed because the last step wrote all cases in one long transaction and Supabase closed the connection. That step now commits every 25 cases (`backend/app/cases/pipeline.py`, `WRITE_BATCH`).
11	- The user then decided a stricter rule (`changes.md` is not updated for it yet): a group of signals becomes a case only with **20 distinct customers** whose feedback is at least as much complaint or wish as praise, or **10 distinct customers reporting a defect**, in one BMW line, or with competitor evidence. A group below the bar becomes **no case** (nothing written, tagged or stored); its signals wait without a case. Counted on Supabase this keeps 48 cases (17 / 13 / 22 for the 5 / 7 / 1 Series) holding 1,676 signals. The user rejected redefining a signal as a bundle of five reports.
12	- Commit `9f370f0` holds this rule, the batching, the reset script and the LLM cache of the build. **None of it has been run or tested.**
13	
14	Steps, in this order. Ask the user before each one that touches Supabase or OpenAI.
15	
16	1. `cd backend && uv run pytest` (offline, about 4 minutes). One test in `tests/test_cases.py` was rewritten for the new rule and never run; other assertions in that file may need the same adjustment. Fix until green.
17	2. `uv run python -m app.cases.reset` (dry run: prints what people have worked on and the number of cases; every count except `cases` must be 0).
18	3. `uv run python -m app.cases.reset --yes`: removes every case on Supabase and sets the opening rule on every config. Signals are kept and only lose their case. It refuses when a person has worked on a case. Not reversible.
19	4. `LLM_WORKERS=12 uv run python -m app.demo build`: skips the finished seed and the embedded signals, groups again under the new rule, then figures, tags, scores, search index, demo users. The case pages and tags of the groups that stay are in the LLM cache (`backend/.data/llm_cache`), so the only new OpenAI cost should be the embeddings of the search index (about 13,000 short texts). Expect minutes, not hours: 48 cases instead of 1,657.
20	5. Check: `select count(*) from case_item` (about 48), `select vehicle, state, count(*) from case_vehicle group by 1, 2`, a few case pages, `select count(*) from case_score`, `select count(*) from rag_chunk`, `select count(*) from app_user` (8), `select pg_size_pretty(pg_database_size(current_database()))` (was 201 MB before the reset; the limit is 500 MB).
21	
22	If step 4 fails: read the last rows of `agent_run` (a row left on `running` with no process behind it is dead: set it to `failed`), then run the same command again. Finished steps are skipped and no LLM answer is paid twice. The search index step embeds inside one transaction; if that is the step that drops, run `uv run python -m app.rag.index` on its own.
23	
24	Do not run `app.demo e2e` on Supabase: it confirms and approves a case in the real data.
25	
26	## 2. What this session changed
27	
28	**Schema (new migrations, never edit an applied one):**
29	- `0014_ui_alignment.sql`: 15 tables and many columns for what the UI shows (briefs, stances, questions, meeting notes, proposals, referrals, innovation pool, comments, alerts, vehicle plan, requirement versions / feedback / checks, owners and workflow per case and line, sign-off statuses).
30	- `0015_rag_pm_context.sql`: the search index may hold PM context.
31	- `0016_size_budget.sql`: two vector indexes dropped, embeddings stored with 768 dimensions (`EMBEDDING_DIM`), `rag_search` takes a vector of any size.
32	- Supabase has all 16. **The local database has 0001 to 0015 only.** Applying 0016 locally clears its embeddings and its search index; they must be rebuilt after (`python -m app.signals.embed`, `python -m app.rag.index`).
33	
34	**Pipeline and agents:**
35	- Prompts `case_writer@v2`, `case_tags@v2`, `requirement_writer@v2`, `rag_agent@v2`. Tried against OpenAI: case writer and case tags (good output on three real cases). **Never run against OpenAI: `requirement_writer@v2` and `rag_agent@v2`.**
36	- Models and thinking effort (`app/config.py`): gpt-6-luna with effort `low` for `feedback_classify`, `signal_extract`, `case_writer`, `case_tags`; gpt-6-luna with the default effort for the RAG agent; gpt-6.1-sol with the default effort for `requirement_writer`. gpt-6-luna has no `minimal` effort (the API accepts none, low, medium, high, xhigh).
37	- The LLM never works inside a database transaction any more (seed, case pipeline, backfill). The three earlier Supabase attempts failed in `seed:feedback` with dropped connections while the connection waited on the LLM.
38	- Observed cases are not scored; a case is scored when it opens. Machine events are not indexed for the RAG agent; the PM context is.
39	- Fetch loop: a record the LLM finds nothing in keeps only a marker row (relevance filter). YouTube: videos of the last 60 days, the 10 most relevant comments per video. Wikipedia and Wikidata are called as official APIs (robots.txt refused them before).
40	
41	**API and UI:**
42	- About 40 new endpoints in `backend/app/api/routers/workspace.py`, services in `backend/app/collab/`.
43	- The adapter in `web/src/backend/` serves all 67 endpoints of the UI contract from the API (`DATA_SOURCE=backend`). The JSON sidecar and the persona table are gone; users are `app_user` rows.
44	- UI fixes: brief page on a brief pre-filled from data, drag and drop on the case board, readable audit lines and proposal cards (`web/src/lib/audit.ts`).

46	## 3. Decisions made in this session
47	
48	Each one is also a row of `changes.md` (U.1 to U.24). "User" = decided by the user in the session; "Claude" = proposed and applied by the assistant, not objected to.

51	|---|---|---|

53	| The adapter serves the whole UI contract from the API; mock and real data are never mixed; the sidecar file is gone | The earlier adapter showed mock cases next to real signals | Claude |
54	| The case lifecycle keeps its four states; the PM's steps are `workflow`, the decision is `outcome` | The UI has six states and six outcomes; the documented lifecycle stays the source of truth | Claude |

65	| Size budget for the free plan: no vector index on `signal` and `rag_chunk`, 768 dimensions, no scores for observed cases, no machine events in the search index | The local build was 789 MB, the plan allows 500 MB | User asked for a solution; measures by Claude |
66	| gpt-6-luna with thinking `low` for classification, extraction, case pages and tags; default thinking for the RAG agent; gpt-6.1-sol with default thinking for requirements | Reading tasks need little reasoning. The user asked for "minimal", the model does not offer it; "none" was tried and the user chose "low" | User |
67	| YouTube: videos of the last 2 months, 10 comments per video, comments and transcripts | A few strong, recent voices per video | User |
68	| Keep the mock in the repository as the offline fallback | Demo safety; the adapter reuses its deterministic logic | Assistant's advice, not objected to |
69	| Migrations 0014 to 0016 applied on Supabase and the build started with OpenAI | "Now try to migrate the work to Supabase"; "run the Supabase migration using OpenAI" | User |
70	
71	Not decided yet (ask the user): running the YouTube fetch into Supabase; what to do about the 1 GB storage limit before a web backfill; whether `case_writer.jsonl` of the LLM cache is shared in git; real user accounts instead of the eight demo people.
72	
73	## 4. Not verified
74	
75	- **The full backend suite was last run before the final edits.** 122 tests passed after the pipeline and size changes. Edited after that and covered only by partial runs (fetch, foundation and signal tests pass): relevance filter, YouTube window and comment limit, thinking effort, cache keys. Run `cd backend && uv run pytest` (about 4 minutes, offline).
76	- **`npm run adapter-flow` passed (34 calls) before** the RAG, scoring and size changes. Run it again against a local database (see section 7).
77	- The screens were opened on real data once (login, brief, desk, case board, case page, requirement page, signals, audit). The vehicle plan page was only checked through its endpoint. The readable audit lines were checked in mock mode only.
78	- Database size on Supabase after the size changes: estimated, not measured.
79	
80	## 5. Open work, in order
81	
82	1. Finish and check the Supabase build (section 1).
83	2. Run the full test suite, then commit. Ask the user before committing. Include `backend/.data/llm_cache/feedback_classify.jsonl` (the shared cache now holds the real classifications) and decide with the user whether `case_writer.jsonl` is shared too.
84	3. Update the design documents. Only `changes.md` reflects this session. Still describing the old state: `database-design.md` (source of truth for tables), `data-model.mmd`, `INTEGRATION-GUIDE.md`, `backend/API.md`, `CLAUDE.md` (current phase, models, embedding size), `plan.md`, `web/README.md`.
85	4. Switch the UI to the Supabase-backed API: run the API with `AUTH_MODE=dev` (or Supabase tokens), `web/.env.local` with `DATA_SOURCE=backend` and `BACKEND_URL`. The demo users have fixed ids (`backend/app/demo.py`).
86	5. YouTube comments into Supabase. Proposed to the user, **not confirmed**: `uv run python -m app.fetch.worker --sources youtube-comments` (about 3,000 of 10,000 daily quota units, at most 1,500 comments). Ask first.
87	6. Try `requirement_writer@v2` and `rag_agent@v2` with OpenAI on one confirmed case before the demo.
88	
89	## 6. Known problems
90	
91	- **Fetch sources** (`backend/reports/fetch_smoke.md`, live check with `python -m app.fetch.smoke`): 32 of 81 returned records. 34 were reachable but returned nothing for the 5 Series; it is not known whether the parser misses the content or no article named the car. Blocked: `kbb`, `whatcar` (403), `autoscout24` (robots.txt). Broken: `press-lexus` (TLS handshake), `google-trends` (the library fails with the installed urllib3, `method_whitelist`). YouTube transcripts: every download answered `IpBlocked` from this machine.
92	- **Raw web pages** go to the Supabase storage bucket, 1 GB on the free plan. The planned backfill (about 29,000 requests) would exceed it. Decide before the first real fetch.
93	- **UI limits on real data:** the Refresh button returns 501 (the fetch loop is started by the worker only); the Signals diagram reads at most 2,000 signals (an aggregate endpoint `GET /signals/flow` exists, the diagram does not use it); a brief change lists affected requirements but does not redraft them; the scripted chat shortcuts of the mock (draft a requirement, questions for engineering) are not ported; the brand-fit slider has no effect and `reach` has no slider; the head overview covers the caller's line only.
94	- **Local database** (`backend/.data/pg`): holds test writes of this session (two confirmed cases, `REQ-G60-0273`, `REQ-G60-1160`, Lena's brief) and template texts, not LLM texts. Rebuild it with `python -m app.demo build --fresh` when a clean local copy is needed.
95	- `web/package-lock.json` changed: `npm ci` failed on a lockfile out of step with `package.json`, so `npm install` was run.
96	
97	## 7. How to run
98	
99	- **Tests:** `cd backend && uv run pytest` (embedded Postgres, no network, no OpenAI). Tests no longer write to the shared LLM cache.
100	- **API on the local database, offline:** `cd backend && uv run python -m app.dev_local` (port 8000; no Supabase, no OpenAI, whatever `backend/.env` says).
101	- **UI:** `cd web && npm run dev`. Mock data by default; real data with `web/.env.local` containing `DATA_SOURCE=backend` and `BACKEND_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8000`. That file exists now and points at the local API: delete it to return to the mock.
102	- **End-to-end check of the adapter** (writes, local database only): `API_BASE=http://localhost:3000/api npm run adapter-flow`.
103	- **Live check of the fetch sources** (real requests, nothing stored): `cd backend && uv run python -m app.fetch.smoke [--sources a,b] [--cap 20]`.
104	- Commands that read `backend/.env` talk to Supabase and OpenAI. For local work prefix them with `SUPABASE_DB_URL= SUPABASE_URL= OPENAI_API_KEY= EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=local STORAGE_BACKEND=local`.
105	- Git Bash: a heredoc that contains an apostrophe breaks. Write the script to a file and run it.
106	
107	## 8. How the user wants to work
108	
109	- Ask before running backend processes, tests, builds, fetches or anything on Supabase or OpenAI; say what will run and what it costs. The user stopped a test run that was started without being asked.
110	- Text in the UI is readable prose, never raw JSON.
111	- BMW's provided data is never dropped; irrelevant rows are kept out of cases, scores and the index (quarantine, out of scope), not deleted. Web records without a relevant statement are not kept.
112	- Load the database from BMW's original files, not from the processed CSVs.
